::: {#heading}
PhD in statistics / machine learning at the [*Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology --- BIPS*](https://www.bips-institut.de) in Bremen.
From 2021 until April 2026, I did my PhD in a position shared between BIPS and the [*Chair of Statistical Learning and Data Science (SLDS)*](https://www.slds.stat.uni-muenchen.de) of LMU Munich 
in association with the [*Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)*](https://mcml.ai/).
